neighbours.label: positive-feeling word that completes a wish or exclamation (' love' after 'I would', ' happy', a 'relaxing day', 'how cool is that')
fire: If you have a spare moment, I would love to hear how the trip went.
Thank you all for giving us such a lovely, relaxing day at the lake!
They deliver fresh bread to your door every morning. How cool is that?
All I want is for the kids to feel happy when they open their presents.
Next summer we would love to visit you and the new baby in Lisbon.
What a wonderful, sunny day we had at the beach with the whole family!
Honestly, I just want my grandmother to be happy and comfortable at home.
My friend learned to juggle five balls in a week. How amazing is that?
quiet: If you have a spare moment, I would need to see the receipts from the trip.
Thank you all for sending the invoice for the repairs at the lake house.
They deliver fresh bread to your door every morning at a fixed price.
All I want is for the kids to put their shoes away when they come in.
Next summer we will have to renew the passports before going to Lisbon.
The meeting at the beach office was moved to Thursday afternoon at three.
Honestly, I just want my grandmother to sign the forms for the bank.
My friend counted the boxes in the warehouse twice in a single week.

notes: Card top: ' love' x6 (I would love to), ' day' (relaxing day!), ' that' (How cool is that?), ' happy'. Near misses keep the sentence frames with neutral words.
